en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 6.  It is narrated that Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) said, “Surely, the Almighty  Allah  frees  a  large  number  of  people  on  every night   of   the   month   of   Ramadan.   However   one   who concludes  his  fast  with  an intoxicant won’t be  freed. The number  of  people  freed  in  one  night  of  the  month  of 2 Surah Momin 40:60 Ramadan is equal to the number of people freed in all the past nights.”
